claims: McDonald's has launched special KPop Demon Hunters meals starting March 31, 2026.
The special KPop Demon Hunters meals are inspired by the animated film.
The HUNTR/X Meal includes 10-piece Chicken McNuggets.
The HUNTR/X Meal includes Ramyeon McShaker Fries with soy, garlic, sesame seasoning.
The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal includes a Sausage McMuffin with Egg topped with a peppery Spicy Saja Sauce.
The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is served with hash browns.
The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is served with a drink.
The Derpy McFlurry is vanilla soft serve blended with popping berry pearls and wild berry sauce.
Each meal comes with a collectible pack containing a photo card of either the HUNTR/X or Saja Boys characters.
The meals include a "Derpy the Tiger" card with a QR code.
The QR code on the "Derpy the Tiger" card can be scanned in the McDonald's App to unlock exclusive digital content from the film by April 26.
